scope: Post-training resource diagnostic fixed after the native dendrite trial; original training and graph support remain untouched. No tuning or early stopping.
test: For each mature receiver keep the largest quarter (ceil) of nonzero pair coefficients by absolute value, or a uniform random subset of exactly the same size in that receiver. Keep all unary weights and arcs. Compare both with intact control on the next 128 fresh never-taught foods after the original Q-removal probe range. Identical zero starting activity, silent feedback, and physical scoring.
inference: Predeclared noninferiority margin minus 2 percentage points for top quarter vs intact in each environment. Also compare top vs random quarter. Four simultaneous two-sided 95% Bonferroni crossed bootstrap intervals over paired graph births and world roots. This measures retained predictive coefficients after training, not learning with a smaller budget.
